column5:
Chỉ số rủi ro hệ thống tổng hợp từ các yếu tố:
▪ Thanh khoản
▪ Biến động chỉ số VN-Index
▪ Dư nợ margin
▪ Lãi suất liên ngân hàng
▪ Dòng tiền ròng NĐTNN
▪ Huy động vốn cổ phần thông qua thị trường chứng khoán
▪ Risk Index được tính toán theo công thức hồi quy (Logistic Regression):
RI = β0 + β1*Z_L + β2*Z_V + β3*Z_M + β4*Z_I + β5*Z_F + β6*Z_C + ε
Trong đó:
o Các biến Z là các giá trị đã được chuẩn hóa (Z-Score) của các yếu tố đầu vào
o Biến động (Volatility - V): Độ lệch chuẩn của lợi suất chỉ số VN-Index trong 30 phiên gần nhất.
o Thanh khoản (Liquidity - L): Chỉ số Amihud (ILLIQ) phản ánh mức độ thanh khoản của thị trường.
o Dư nợ ký quỹ (Margin Debt - M): Tỷ lệ Dư nợ Margin trên Tổng vốn hóa thị trường.
o Lãi suất (Interest Rate - I): Lãi suất liên ngân hàng.
o Dòng tiền ròng NĐTNN (Net Foreign - F)
o Huy động vốn cổ phần (Equity Capital Raising - C)
▪ Các giá trị β, ε do cán bộ/chuyên viên nhập.
▪ Công thức chuẩn hóa Z-Score:
1. Công thức tổng quát:
Z-score = (x − μ) / σ

WITH close_price AS (
-- Bước 0: lấy đúng 1 dòng/ngày = giá đóng cửa (bản ghi indexTime lớn nhất)
SELECT TradingDate,
marketIndex AS CloseIndex
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
WHERE IndexCode = 'HOSE'
AND TradingDate <= :input_date
AND indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(m2.indexTime)
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR m2
WHERE m2.IndexCode = 'HOSE'
AND m2.TradingDate = JAD_MARKETINFOR.TradingDate
)
),
daily_ret AS (
-- Bước 1: tính log return
SELECT TradingDate,
LN(CloseIndex / LAG(CloseIndex) OVER (ORDER BY TradingDate)) AS r
FROM close_price
ORDER BY TradingDate DESC
FETCH FIRST 31 ROWS ONLY 
),
vol30 AS (
-- Bước 2: tính σ_t = độ lệch chuẩn mẫu của 30 log-return
SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(r) AS sigma_v
FROM daily_ret
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
),
hist AS (
-- Bước 3: lấy μ và σ lịch sử từ DWH để chuẩn hóa
SELECT AVG(sigma_v_hist) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(sigma_v_hist) AS sd
FROM mart.volatility_history
WHERE trading_date <= :input_date
)
-- Bước 4: Z-score = (σ_t − μ) / σ_lịch_sử
SELECT v.sigma_v AS volatility_30d,
h.mu AS mu_hist,
h.sd AS sd_hist,
(v.sigma_v - h.mu) / NULLIF(h.sd, 0) AS z_score_volatility
FROM vol30 v
CROSS JOIN hist h;

WITH idx_return AS (
-- Tính lợi suất log từng ngày trước
SELECT
trading_date,
ABS(LN(close_index/NULLIF(LAG(close_index) OVER (ORDER BY trading_date),0))) AS abs_rt
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
WHERE index_code='HOSE'
),
illiq_d AS (
-- Tính ILLIQₜ = |Rₜ| / VOLDₜ mỗi ngày
SELECT
t.trade_date,
r.abs_rt/NULLIF(SUM(t.exec_value),0) AS illiq_t
FROM (
SELECT trade_date, "Execution - Value" AS exec_value, "Board Type" AS board_type
FROM trade_hose
WHERE "Market ID" IN ('STO')
AND trade_date<=:input_date
UNION ALL
SELECT trade_date, trade_price*trade_quantity AS exec_value, "Board ID" AS board_type
FROM trade_hnx
WHERE "Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
AND trade_date<=:input_date
) t
JOIN idx_return r ON r.trading_date=t.trade_date
WHERE t.board_type IN ('G1','G2','G3')
GROUP BY t.trade_date,r.abs_rt
ORDER BY t.trade_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY
),
illiq_30 AS (
-- ILLIQ30 = trung bình 30 phiên gần nhất
SELECT AVG(illiq_t) AS illiq_avg
FROM illiq_d
)
SELECT
(illiq_30.illiq_avg-hist.mu)/NULLIF(hist.sd,0) AS z_score_liquidity,
STDDEV_SAMP(h.illiq_30_hist) AS sigma_illiq
FROM illiq_30,
(
SELECT
AVG(illiq_30_hist) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(illiq_30_hist) AS sd
FROM mart.illiq_history
WHERE trading_date<=:input_date
) hist,
mart.illiq_history h
WHERE h.trading_date<=:input_date
GROUP BY illiq_30.illiq_avg,hist.mu,hist.sd;

WITH
mcap_ngay AS (
SELECT
g.tradingdate,
SUM(g.closePrice * s.kl_luu_hanh) AS tong_von_hoa
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR g
JOIN (
SELECT b.MCK, b.ngay_bc, SUM(b.KLLH) AS kl_luu_hanh
FROM BM1_BCKLLH b
WHERE b.loai_ck = N'Cổ phiếu'
AND b.ngay_bc BETWEEN TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '29' DAY
AND TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY b.MCK, b.ngay_bc
) s ON s.MCK = g.symbol
AND s.ngay_bc = g.tradingdate
WHERE g.tradingdate BETWEEN TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '29' DAY
AND TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND g.StockType NOT IN ('B','1','BO','D')
GROUP BY g.tradingdate
),
du_no_margin_thang AS (
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR,
mr.PERIOD,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%ii. giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) BETWEEN
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '29' DAY) * 100
+ EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '29' DAY)
AND
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD')) * 100
+ EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
),
ratio_ngay AS (
SELECT
m.tradingdate,
d.du_no_margin AS mdt,
m.tong_von_hoa AS mcapt,
d.du_no_margin / NULLIF(m.tong_von_hoa, 0) AS rt
FROM mcap_ngay m
JOIN du_no_margin_thang d
ON d.REPORT_YEAR = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.tradingdate)
AND d.PERIOD = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.tradingdate)
),
thong_ke AS (
SELECT
tradingdate,
mdt,
mcapt,
rt,
AVG(rt) OVER (ORDER BY tradingdate ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mu,
STDDEV(rt) OVER (ORDER BY tradingdate ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sigma,
COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY tradingdate ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
FROM ratio_ngay
)
SELECT
TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ngay_gd,
mdt,
mcapt,
ROUND(rt * 100, 4) AS margin_ratio_pct,
ROUND(mu * 100, 4) AS r_bar_pct,
ROUND(sigma * 100, 4) AS sigma_volatility_pct,
n AS so_ngay,
ROUND((rt - mu) / NULLIF(sigma, 0), 4) AS z_score
FROM thong_ke
WHERE tradingdate = TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD');

WITH dong_tien_rong_ngay AS (
-- Rt: Dòng tiền ròng NĐTNN tại từng ngày
SELECT
idx.indexCode,
m.ngay_gd,
SUM(m.gt_gd) - SUM(b.gt_gd) AS rt
FROM (
SELECT t.Symbol AS symbol, t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd, t.[Execution - Value] AS gt_gd
FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Market ID] = 'STO'
AND t.[Buy Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
UNION ALL
SELECT
t.[Issue Code],
t.[Trade date],
CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC) * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
AND t.[Buy Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
) m(symbol, ngay_gd, gt_gd)
JOIN (
SELECT t.Symbol AS symbol, t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd, t.[Execution - Value] AS gt_gd
FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Market ID] = 'STO'
AND t.[Sell Foreigner Investor type] IN ('10','20')
UNION ALL
SELECT
t.[Issue Code],
t.[Trade date],
CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC) * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
AND t.[Sell Foreign Investor Type Code] IN ('10','20')
) b(symbol, ngay_gd, gt_gd)
ON b.symbol = m.symbol AND b.ngay_gd = m.ngay_gd
JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
ON idx.symbol = m.symbol AND idx.tradingdate = m.ngay_gd
WHERE idx.indexCode = :ma_chi_so
AND m.ngay_gd <= :input_date
GROUP BY idx.indexCode, m.ngay_gd
),
return_window AS (
-- Lấy N phiên gần nhất để tính μ và σ
SELECT ngay_gd, rt
FROM dong_tien_rong_ngay
ORDER BY ngay_gd DESC
FETCH FIRST :n_phien ROWS ONLY
),
x_today AS (
-- x: Dòng tiền ròng tại ngày input
SELECT rt AS x
FROM dong_tien_rong_ngay
WHERE ngay_gd = :input_date
),
stat AS (
-- μ: trung bình, σ: độ lệch chuẩn của N phiên
SELECT
AVG(rt) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(rt) AS sigma
FROM return_window
)
SELECT
:input_date AS ngay_tinh,
x_today.x AS dong_tien_rong_hom_nay,
stat.mu AS dong_tien_rong_binh_quan,
stat.sigma AS sigma_volatility,
-- Z-score = (μ - x) / σ
(stat.mu - x_today.x) / NULLIF(stat.sigma, 0) AS z_score_dong_tien_rong
FROM stat, x_today;

GROUP BY dso.DOCUMENT_DATE

-- x_t: huy động vốn cổ phần theo từng ngày (phiên)

NGAY,

FROM huy_dong_theo_nguon
WHERE NGAY IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY NGAY
),
n_phien_gan_nhat AS (
-- N = 20 phiên gần nhất, kèm sẵn μ và σ bằng window function
SELECT
NGAY,
RT,
AVG(RT) OVER () AS MU, -- μ: trung bình 20 phiên
STDDEV(RT) OVER () AS SIGMA, -- σ: độ lệch chuẩn 20 phiên
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NGAY DESC) AS RN
FROM (
SELECT NGAY, RT
FROM huy_dong_theo_ngay
ORDER BY NGAY DESC
FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
)
)
SELECT
NGAY,
RT AS X,
MU,
SIGMA,
(MU - RT) / SIGMA AS Z_SCORE_DAO_CHIEU -- Z = (μ - x) / σ
FROM n_phien_gan_nhat
WHERE RN = 1; -- x: giá trị của phiên hiện tại (gần nhất)

FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
WHERE s.tradingdate = :ngay_gd

scplh AS (
SELECT

SUM(b.KLLH) AS kl_luu_hanh
FROM BM1_BCKLLH b
WHERE b.loai_ck = N'Cổ phiếu'
AND b.ngay_bc = :ngay_gd
GROUP BY b.MCK

mcap AS (
SELECT
SUM(g.gia_dong_cua * s.kl_luu_hanh) AS tong_von_hoa
FROM gdongcua g
JOIN scplh s ON s.MCK = g.symbol
),
du_no_margin AS (
SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%ii. giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS tong_du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND mr.REPORT_YEAR = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND mr.PERIOD = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
)

TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ngay_gd,
d.tong_du_no_margin AS mdt,
m.tong_von_hoa AS mcapt,
ROUND(d.tong_du_no_margin / NULLIF(m.tong_von_hoa,0) * 100, 4) AS margin_ratio_pct
FROM du_no_margin d
INNER JOIN mcap m ON 1=1;

WITH close_price AS (
-- Bước 0: lấy đúng 1 dòng/ngày = giá đóng cửa (bản ghi indexTime lớn nhất)
SELECT TradingDate,
marketIndex AS CloseIndex
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate <= :input_date
AND indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(m2.indexTime)
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR m2
WHERE m2.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m2.TradingDate = JAD_MARKETINFOR.TradingDate
)
),
daily_ret AS (
-- Bước 1: tính log return, lấy 31 ngày → được 30 log-return sau khi LAG cho NULL ở dòng đầu
SELECT TradingDate,
LN(CloseIndex / LAG(CloseIndex) OVER (ORDER BY TradingDate)) AS r
FROM close_price
ORDER BY TradingDate DESC
FETCH FIRST 31 ROWS ONLY 
),
vol30 AS (
-- Bước 2: tính σ_t = độ lệch chuẩn mẫu của 30 log-return
SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(r) AS sigma_v
FROM daily_ret
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
),
hist AS (
-- Bước 3: lấy μ và σ lịch sử từ DWH để chuẩn hóa
SELECT AVG(sigma_v_hist) AS mu,
STDDEV_SAMP(sigma_v_hist) AS sd
FROM mart.volatility_history
WHERE trading_date <= :input_date
)
-- Bước 4: Z-score = (σ_t − μ) / σ_lịch_sử
SELECT v.sigma_v AS volatility_30d,
h.mu AS mu_hist,
h.sd AS sd_hist,
(v.sigma_v - h.mu) / NULLIF(h.sd, 0) AS z_score_volatility
FROM vol30 v
CROSS JOIN hist h;

AND TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND g.StockType NOT IN ('B','1','BO','D')
GROUP BY g.tradingdate
),
du_no_margin_thang AS (
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR,
mr.PERIOD,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%ii. giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr

JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2,3,6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) BETWEEN
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '29' DAY) * 100
+ EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '29' DAY)
AND
EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD')) * 100
+ EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(:ngay_gd,'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)

)

ratio_ngay AS (

m.tradingdate,
d.du_no_margin AS mdt,

d.du_no_margin / NULLIF(m.tong_von_hoa, 0) AS rt
FROM mcap_ngay m

thong_ke AS (

tradingdate,
mdt,
mcapt,
rt,

COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY tradingdate ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
FROM ratio_ngay
)

mdt,
mcapt,
ROUND(rt * 100, 4) AS margin_ratio_pct,
ROUND(mu * 100, 4) AS r_bar_pct,
ROUND(sigma * 100, 4) AS sigma_volatility_pct,
n AS so_ngay,
ROUND((rt - mu) / NULLIF(sigma, 0), 4) AS z_score
FROM thong_ke

FROM (

FROM trade_hose
WHERE "Market ID" IN ('STO')
AND trade_date<=:input_date
UNION ALL
SELECT trade_date, trade_price*trade_quantity AS exec_value, "Board ID" AS board_type
FROM trade_hnx
WHERE "Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
AND trade_date<=:input_date
) t
JOIN idx_return r ON r.trading_date=t.trade_date
WHERE t.board_type IN ('G1','G2','G3')
GROUP BY t.trade_date,r.abs_rt
ORDER BY t.trade_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

illiq_30 AS (

STDDEV_SAMP(h.illiq_30_hist) AS sigma_illiq
FROM illiq_30,

STDDEV_SAMP(illiq_30_hist) AS sd

WHERE trading_date<=:input_date

WITH huy_dong_theo_nguon AS (
SELECT
sof.OFFICIAL_LETTER_DATE AS NGAY,
SUM(res.TOTAL_COLLECTED_AM) AS SO_TIEN
FROM IDS.SECURITIES_OFFERING sof
JOIN IDS.SECURITIES_OFFERING_PLAN sop
ON sop.SECURITIES_OFFERING_ID = sof.ID
JOIN IDS.SECURITIES_OFFERING_RESULT res
ON res.SECURITIES_OFFERING_ID = sof.ID
WHERE sop.OFFERING_METHOD_CD IN ('1','2','3','5','9','11')
GROUP BY sof.OFFICIAL_LETTER_DATE

UNION ALL

SELECT
dso.DOCUMENT_DATE AS NGAY,
SUM(dso.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED) AS SO_TIEN
FROM SCMS.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
WHERE dso.OFFERING_TYPE IN ('1', '4', '5', '6', '7')
GROUP BY dso.DOCUMENT_DATE

UNION ALL

SELECT
o.APPROVAL_DOCUMENT_DATE AS NGAY,
SUM(o.ACTUAL_TOTAL_VALUE) AS SO_TIEN
FROM FMS.OFFERING o
GROUP BY o.APPROVAL_DOCUMENT_DATE
),
huy_dong_theo_ngay AS (
-- x_t: huy động vốn cổ phần theo từng ngày (phiên)
SELECT
NGAY,
SUM(SO_TIEN) AS RT
FROM huy_dong_theo_nguon
WHERE NGAY IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY NGAY
),
n_phien_gan_nhat AS (
-- N = 20 phiên gần nhất, kèm sẵn μ và σ bằng window function
SELECT
NGAY,
RT,
AVG(RT) OVER () AS MU, -- μ: trung bình 20 phiên
STDDEV(RT) OVER () AS SIGMA, -- σ: độ lệch chuẩn 20 phiên
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NGAY DESC) AS RN
FROM (
SELECT NGAY, RT
FROM huy_dong_theo_ngay
ORDER BY NGAY DESC
FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
)
)
SELECT
NGAY,
RT AS X,
MU,
SIGMA,
(MU - RT) / SIGMA AS Z_SCORE_DAO_CHIEU -- Z = (μ - x) / σ
FROM n_phien_gan_nhat
WHERE RN = 1; -- x: giá trị của phiên hiện tại (gần nhất)

WITH parkinson AS (
SELECT symbol, tradingdate,
SQRT(
(1.0/(4*20*LN(2)))
* SUM(POWER(LN(CAST(high AS NUMERIC)
/ NULLIF(CAST(low AS NUMERIC),0)), 2))
OVER (PARTITION BY symbol
ORDER BY tradingdate
ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
) AS vp
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
WHERE FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')
),
close_ret AS (

ABS(LN(CAST(closePrice AS NUMERIC)
/ NULLIF(LAG(CAST(closePrice AS NUMERIC))
OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tradingdate), 0)
)) AS vc
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
WHERE FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')
)
SELECT p.symbol,
GREATEST(0, 100 - (c.vc / NULLIF(p.vp, 0)) * 50) AS s_stability
FROM parkinson p
JOIN close_ret c ON c.symbol=p.symbol
AND c.tradingdate=p.tradingdate
WHERE p.tradingdate = :input_date;

-- Margin Tension (%) = Tổng dư nợ margin / Tổng hạn mức margin * 100
-- Tổng hạn mức margin = 2 * VCSH
WITH du_no_margin AS (
-- Dư nợ margin
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%ii. giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr
ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv
ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu * 100 + :p_thang_tu)
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den)
AND :p_thang_tu BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND :p_thang_den BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
),
han_muc_margin AS (
-- Hạn mức margin = 2 * VCSH từ BCTC quý
SELECT
mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr_attc.PERIOD AS thang,
MAX(rcv_bctc.NUMERIC_VALUE) * 2 AS han_muc_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr_attc
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr_attc
ON fr_attc.ID = mr_attc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr_attc.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTLAT'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv_attc
ON rcv_attc.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr_attc.ID
AND rcv_attc.SHEET_NAME = N'06H01'
LEFT JOIN SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr_bctc
ON mr_bctc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr_attc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr_bctc.REPORT_PERIOD = 'Q'
AND mr_bctc.REPORT_YEAR = mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr_bctc.PERIOD = CEIL(mr_attc.PERIOD / 3.0) -- tháng → quý
AND mr_bctc.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr_bctc.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr_bctc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr_bctc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr_bctc.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr_bctc.PERIOD
)
LEFT JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr_bctc
ON fr_bctc.ID = mr_bctc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr_bctc.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRLCTCK'
LEFT JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv_bctc
ON rcv_bctc.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr_bctc.ID
AND rcv_bctc.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTCR'
AND rcv_bctc.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%số cuối năm%'
AND LOWER(rcv_bctc.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%i. vốn chủ sở hữu%'
WHERE mr_attc.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr_attc.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND (mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr_attc.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu * 100 + :p_thang_tu)
AND (mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr_attc.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den)
AND :p_thang_tu BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND :p_thang_den BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr_attc.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr_attc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr_attc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr_attc.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR, mr_attc.PERIOD
)
SELECT
d.nam,
d.thang,
d.du_no_margin,
h.han_muc_margin,
-- Margin Tension (%) = Tổng dư nợ margin / Tổng hạn mức margin * 100
ROUND(
d.du_no_margin / NULLIF(h.han_muc_margin, 0) * 100
, 2) AS margin_tension_pct
FROM du_no_margin d
JOIN han_muc_margin h
ON h.nam = d.nam
AND h.thang = d.thang
ORDER BY d.nam, d.thang;

WITH margin_data AS (
-- Dư nợ margin (toàn thị trường, theo tháng)
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%II. Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr
ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv
ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu * 100 + :p_thang_tu)
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den)
AND :p_thang_tu BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND :p_thang_den BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
),
vcsh_data AS (
-- Tổng hạn mức margin (2 lần VCSH), theo tháng
SELECT
mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr_attc.PERIOD AS thang,
MAX(rcv_bctc.NUMERIC_VALUE) AS von_chu_so_huu,
MAX(rcv_bctc.NUMERIC_VALUE) * 2 AS hai_lan_vcsh
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr_attc
JOIN SSC_SCMS.SC_FIRM_INFO f
ON f.ID = mr_attc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr_attc
ON fr_attc.ID = mr_attc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr_attc.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTLAT'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv_attc
ON rcv_attc.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr_attc.ID
AND rcv_attc.SHEET_NAME = N'06H01'
LEFT JOIN SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr_bctc
ON mr_bctc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr_attc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr_bctc.REPORT_PERIOD = 'Q'
AND mr_bctc.REPORT_YEAR = mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr_bctc.PERIOD = CEIL(mr_attc.PERIOD / 3.0)
AND mr_bctc.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr_bctc.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr_bctc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr_bctc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr_bctc.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr_bctc.PERIOD
)
LEFT JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr_bctc
ON fr_bctc.ID = mr_bctc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr_bctc.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRLCTCK'
LEFT JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv_bctc
ON rcv_bctc.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr_bctc.ID
AND rcv_bctc.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTCR'
AND rcv_bctc.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%số cuối năm%'
AND LOWER(rcv_bctc.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%i. vốn chủ sở hữu%'
WHERE mr_attc.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr_attc.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND (mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr_attc.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu * 100 + :p_thang_tu)
AND (mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr_attc.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den)
AND :p_thang_tu BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND :p_thang_den BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr_attc.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr_attc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr_attc.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr_attc.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr_attc.REPORT_YEAR, mr_attc.PERIOD
)
SELECT
margin_data.nam,
margin_data.thang,
ROUND(
margin_data.du_no_margin
/ NULLIF(vcsh_data.hai_lan_vcsh, 0)
* 100,
2
) AS margin_tension_pct,
CASE
WHEN ROUND(margin_data.du_no_margin / NULLIF(vcsh_data.hai_lan_vcsh, 0) * 100, 2) < 50 THEN 'Dư dả'
WHEN ROUND(margin_data.du_no_margin / NULLIF(vcsh_data.hai_lan_vcsh, 0) * 100, 2) < 70 THEN 'Tối ưu'
WHEN ROUND(margin_data.du_no_margin / NULLIF(vcsh_data.hai_lan_vcsh, 0) * 100, 2) < 85 THEN 'Căng'
WHEN ROUND(margin_data.du_no_margin / NULLIF(vcsh_data.hai_lan_vcsh, 0) * 100, 2) < 95 THEN 'Báo động'
ELSE 'Vi phạm'
END AS trang_thai
FROM margin_data
LEFT JOIN vcsh_data
ON vcsh_data.nam = margin_data.nam
AND vcsh_data.thang = margin_data.thang
ORDER BY margin_data.nam, margin_data.thang;

WITH trading_dates_current AS (
SELECT TradingDate
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT TradingDate,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TradingDate DESC) AS rn
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate <= :input_date
)
WHERE rn <= 21
),
close_prices_current AS (
SELECT
m.TradingDate,
m.marketIndex AS close_index
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR m
WHERE m.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m.TradingDate IN (SELECT TradingDate FROM trading_dates_current)
AND m.indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(indexTime)
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate = m.TradingDate
)
),
daily_return_current AS (
SELECT
cp.TradingDate,
(cp.close_index - prev.close_index)
/ NULLIF(prev.close_index, 0) AS rt
FROM close_prices_current cp
JOIN close_prices_current prev
ON prev.TradingDate = (
SELECT MAX(TradingDate)
FROM close_prices_current
WHERE TradingDate < cp.TradingDate
)
),
sigma_current AS (
SELECT STDDEV(rt) * SQRT(252) AS sigma_cur
FROM daily_return_current
),
-- Tính σ_max: stddev cao nhất lịch sử theo rolling 20 phiên
all_close_prices AS (
SELECT
m.TradingDate,
m.marketIndex AS close_index
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR m
WHERE m.IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND m.indexTime = (
SELECT MAX(indexTime)
FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
WHERE IndexCode = 'VNINDEX'
AND TradingDate = m.TradingDate
)
),
all_daily_return AS (
SELECT
cp.TradingDate,
(cp.close_index - prev.close_index)
/ NULLIF(prev.close_index, 0) AS rt
FROM all_close_prices cp
JOIN all_close_prices prev
ON prev.TradingDate = (
SELECT MAX(TradingDate)
FROM all_close_prices
WHERE TradingDate < cp.TradingDate
)
),
rolling_sigma AS (
SELECT
TradingDate,
STDDEV(rt) OVER (
ORDER BY TradingDate
ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
) * SQRT(252) AS sigma_rolling
FROM all_daily_return
),
sigma_max AS (
SELECT MAX(sigma_rolling) AS sigma_max
FROM rolling_sigma
WHERE TradingDate <= :input_date
)
SELECT
:input_date AS trading_date,
sigma_current.sigma_cur AS sigma_current,
sigma_max.sigma_max AS sigma_max,
ROUND(
sigma_current.sigma_cur
/ NULLIF(sigma_max.sigma_max, 0) * 100,
2
) AS systemic_vol_pct
FROM sigma_current, sigma_max;

WITH daily_ret AS (
SELECT symbol, tradingdate,
LN(CAST(closePrice AS NUMERIC)/
LAG(CAST(closePrice AS NUMERIC)) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY tradingdate)) AS r
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
WHERE FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')
AND tradingdate <= :input_date
),
sigma AS (
SELECT symbol, STDDEV(r) AS sigma_i
FROM daily_ret
WHERE r IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY symbol
),
sigma_range AS (
SELECT MIN(sigma_i) AS sigma_min, MAX(sigma_i) AS sigma_max FROM sigma
)
SELECT s.symbol,
(s.sigma_i - sr.sigma_min) / NULLIF(sr.sigma_max - sr.sigma_min, 0) * 100 AS pvolatility_i
FROM sigma s CROSS JOIN sigma_range sr

WITH
-- Bước 1: Tính TotalValue_Sector
total_value AS (
SELECT

SUM(CAST(si.totalTradingValue AS NUMERIC)) AS total_value_sector
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR si
JOIN IDS.company_profile cd ON cd.equity_ticker = si.symbol
WHERE si.tradingdate = :input_date
AND si.FloorCode IN ('02', '04', '10')
GROUP BY cd.category_l1_id
),

-- Bước 2: Tính TotalCap_Sector
gia_dong_cua AS (
SELECT
s.symbol,
s.tradingdate,
s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
s.FloorCode
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
WHERE s.tradingdate = :input_date
AND s.StockType NOT IN ('B', '1', 'BO', 'D')
),
kl_luu_hanh AS (
SELECT
b.MCK,
SUM(b.KLLH) AS kl_luu_hanh
FROM BM1_BCKLLH b
WHERE b.loai_ck = N'Cổ phiếu'
AND b.ngay_bc = :input_date
GROUP BY b.MCK
),
von_hoa_ma AS (
SELECT
g.symbol,
g.FloorCode,
g.gia_dong_cua * k.kl_luu_hanh AS market_cap
FROM gia_dong_cua g
JOIN kl_luu_hanh k ON k.MCK = g.symbol
),
total_cap AS (
SELECT
n.industry_cd AS nganh_id,
SUM(v.market_cap) AS total_cap_sector
FROM von_hoa_ma v
JOIN IDS.company_info ci ON ci.symbol = v.symbol
JOIN IDS.categories n ON n.industry_cd = ci.industry_cd
AND n.active_flg = 1
GROUP BY n.industry_cd
)

-- Bước 3: Tính LiquidScore_Sector = TotalValue / TotalCap
SELECT
:input_date AS ngay_gd,
tc.nganh_id,
tv.total_value_sector,
tc.total_cap_sector,
CASE
WHEN tc.total_cap_sector IS NULL
OR tc.total_cap_sector = 0
THEN NULL
ELSE tv.total_value_sector / tc.total_cap_sector
END AS liquid_score_sector
FROM total_cap tc
LEFT JOIN total_value tv ON tv.nganh_id = tc.nganh_id
ORDER BY liquid_score_sector DESC NULLS LAST;

-- Dư nợ margin
SELECT

mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%II. Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%' THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD' -- Xác nhận tên sheet BC tình hình hoạt động
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6) -- 2=đúng hạn, 3=trễ, 6=nộp lại
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH' -- Kỳ tháng
-- Lọc khoảng từ Tháng/Năm đến Tháng/Năm
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu * 100 + :p_thang_tu)
AND (mr.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + mr.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den)
AND :p_thang_tu BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND :p_thang_den BETWEEN 1 AND 12
-- Chỉ lấy version mới nhất nếu nộp lại
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
ORDER BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD;

-- Δ margin balance = Dư nợ margin tháng t - Dư nợ margin tháng (t-1)
WITH margin_t AS (
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%II. Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr
ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv
ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND mr.REPORT_YEAR = :p_nam
AND mr.PERIOD = :p_thang
AND :p_thang BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
),
margin_t1 AS (
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%II. Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%'
THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr
ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv
ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%năm nay%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
-- Tháng (t-1) tính từ tham số tháng/năm hiện tại (t)
AND mr.REPORT_YEAR = CASE WHEN :p_thang = 1 THEN :p_nam - 1 ELSE :p_nam END
AND mr.PERIOD = CASE WHEN :p_thang = 1 THEN 12 ELSE :p_thang - 1 END
AND :p_thang BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
)
SELECT
margin_t.nam AS nam_t,
margin_t.thang AS thang_t,
margin_t.du_no_margin AS margin_t,
margin_t1.nam AS nam_t1,
margin_t1.thang AS thang_t1,
margin_t1.du_no_margin AS margin_t1,
margin_t.du_no_margin - NVL(margin_t1.du_no_margin, 0) AS delta_margin_balance
FROM margin_t
LEFT JOIN margin_t1 ON 1 = 1; -- mỗi CTE chỉ có 1 dòng (đúng 1 tháng) nên join không điều kiện

WITH

SELECT

WHERE ecb.year = :p_year
AND ecb.month = :p_month
),

-- Buoc 2: Loc doanh nghiep co xep hang tin nhiem thap
dn_rui_ro_cao AS (
SELECT company_id
FROM xep_hang
WHERE xep_hang_tin_nhiem IN (:nguong_xep_hang_thap)
),

-- Buoc 3: Lay thong tin TP dao han cua cac DN co xep hang thap
-- Join voi bang TP qua company_id / issuer
tp_dao_han AS (
SELECT
s.symbol,
s.tradingdate,
s.MaturityDate,
CAST(s.ListedShare AS NUMERIC) AS kl_tp_luu_hanh,
CAST(s.ListedShare AS NUMERIC) * 100000 AS gia_tri_dao_han
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
JOIN IDS.company_profile cd ON cd.equity_ticker = s.symbol
JOIN dn_rui_ro_cao dn ON dn.company_id = cd.company_id
WHERE s.StockType IN ('B','1','D')
AND TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = (
SELECT MAX(TO_DATE(s2.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY'))
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s2
WHERE s2.StockType IN ('B','1','D')
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(s2.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) = :p_year
AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(s2.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) = :p_quarter
)
-- Chi tinh TP dao han trong 12 thang toi (theo spec "ap luc dao han 12T")
AND TO_DATE(s.MaturityDate, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
BETWEEN SYSDATE
AND ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 12)
)

-- Buoc 4: Tong gia tri dao han rui ro cao
SELECT
:p_year AS nam,
:p_quarter AS quy,
COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS so_ma_tp_rui_ro,
SUM(gia_tri_dao_han) AS gt_dao_han_rui_ro_cao

WITH
-- Bước 1: Lấy xếp hạng tín nhiệm mới nhất của từng doanh nghiệp trong kỳ
xep_hang AS (
SELECT
ecb.company_id,
ecb.ranking AS xep_hang_tin_nhiem
FROM evaluation_cbonds ecb
WHERE ecb.year = :p_year
AND ecb.month = :p_month
),
-- Bước 2: Lọc doanh nghiệp có xếp hạng tín nhiệm thấp
dn_rui_ro_cao AS (
SELECT company_id
FROM xep_hang
WHERE xep_hang_tin_nhiem IN (:nguong_xep_hang_thap)
),
-- Bước 3: Trái phiếu riêng lẻ đang lưu hành, kèm giá trị (Mệnh giá * KL lưu hành)
tp_dang_luu_hanh AS (
SELECT
t.MA_TP,
t.COMPANY_ID, -- <-- cần xác nhận: cột liên kết tới doanh nghiệp phát hành
t.MATURITY_DATE, -- <-- cần xác nhận: cột ngày đáo hạn trái phiếu
t.MENH_GIA,
t.KL_LUU_HANH,
t.MENH_GIA * t.KL_LUU_HANH AS DU_NO_TP
FROM VSDC.BM29_QUY_MO_DKGD_KL_LUU_HANH t
WHERE t.LOAI_CK = 'TP_RIENG_LE'
)
-- Bước 4: Giá trị đáo hạn của TP thuộc doanh nghiệp rủi ro cao, trong kỳ đáo hạn cần xét
SELECT
SUM(tp.DU_NO_TP) AS GIA_TRI_DAO_HAN_RUI_RO_CAO
FROM tp_dang_luu_hanh tp
JOIN dn_rui_ro_cao drc
ON drc.company_id = tp.COMPANY_ID
WHERE tp.MATURITY_DATE BETWEEN :p_tu_ngay AND :p_den_ngay; -- kỳ đáo hạn cần xét (VD: 12 tháng tới)

WITH
du_no_nganh AS (
SELECT
c.industry_cd AS ma_nganh,
c.industry_name AS ten_nganh,
SUM(CAST(s.ListedShare AS NUMERIC) * 100000) AS du_no_tp_nganh
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
JOIN IDS.company_info ci ON ci.symbol = s.symbol
JOIN IDS.categories c ON c.industry_cd = ci.industry_cd
AND c.active_flg = 1
WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = :ngay_gd
AND s.StockType IN ('B','1','D')
GROUP BY c.industry_cd, c.industry_name
),
du_no_toan_tt AS (
SELECT
SUM(CAST(s.ListedShare AS NUMERIC) * 100000) AS tong_du_no_tp
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') = :ngay_gd
AND s.StockType IN ('B','1','D')
)
SELECT
:ngay_gd AS ngay_thong_ke,
n.ma_nganh,
n.ten_nganh,
n.du_no_tp_nganh,
t.tong_du_no_tp,
CASE
WHEN t.tong_du_no_tp IS NULL
OR t.tong_du_no_tp = 0 THEN NULL
ELSE ROUND(n.du_no_tp_nganh / t.tong_du_no_tp * 100, 2)
END AS ty_trong_du_no_pct
FROM du_no_nganh n
CROSS JOIN du_no_toan_tt t
ORDER BY n.du_no_tp_nganh DESC;

SELECT

p.company_name_vn AS TEN_TO_CHUC,
c.industry_cd AS MA_NGANH,
c.industry_name AS TEN_NGANH,
CP.equity_ticker AS MA_CK,
SUM(e.data_value) AS NO_PHAI_TRA
FROM (
-- Danh sách TPDN niêm yết: Lấy dữ liệu cuối cùng trong ngày
SELECT
"symbol",
"IssuerName",
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "symbol" ORDER BY "ts" DESC) AS rn
FROM MDDS.JAD_STOCKINFOR
WHERE "FloorCode" = '06'
AND "tradingdate" = :to_date
) TP
JOIN (
-- Thông tin Mã chứng khoán (Mã cổ phiếu): Lấy dữ liệu cuối cùng trong ngày
SELECT
"symbol" AS equity_ticker,
"IssuerName",
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "symbol" ORDER BY "ts" DESC) AS rn
FROM MDDS.JAD_STOCKINFOR
WHERE "FloorCode" IN ('02', '04', '10')
AND "tradingdate" = :to_date
) CP ON CP.rn = 1 AND CP."IssuerName" = TP."IssuerName"
JOIN IDS.company_profiles p ON p.equity_ticker = CP.equity_ticker
JOIN IDS.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN IDS.company_data e ON e.company_profile_id = p.id
JOIN IDS.data d ON d.company_data_id = e.company_data_id
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
WHERE TP.rn = 1
AND rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND e.report_year = :year
AND e.report_quarter = :quarter
AND (
(rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc = '300')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc = '300')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc = '400')
)
GROUP BY
TP."symbol",
p.company_name_vn,
c.industry_cd,
c.industry_name,
CP.equity_ticker;

WITH

-- Tính năm/quý của kỳ TRƯỚC
prev_period AS (
SELECT
CASE WHEN :quarter = 1 THEN :year - 1 ELSE :year END AS prev_year,
CASE WHEN :quarter = 1 THEN 4 ELSE :quarter - 1 END AS prev_quarter
),

-- Danh sách TPDN niêm yết: lấy bản ghi cuối cùng trong ngày
tp AS (
SELECT
s."symbol",
s."IssuerName",
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s."symbol" ORDER BY s."ts" DESC) AS rn
FROM MDDS.JAD_STOCKINFOR s
WHERE s."FloorCode" = '06'
AND s."tradingdate" = :to_date
),

-- Mã cổ phiếu tương ứng: link qua IssuerName
cp AS (
SELECT
s."symbol" AS equity_ticker,
s."IssuerName",
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s."symbol" ORDER BY s."ts" DESC) AS rn
FROM MDDS.JAD_STOCKINFOR s
WHERE s."FloorCode" IN ('02', '04', '10')
AND s."tradingdate" = :to_date
)

SELECT
tp."symbol" AS ma_tp,
c.industry_cd AS ma_nganh,
c.industry_name AS ten_nganh,
cp.equity_ticker AS ma_ck,
pp.prev_year AS nam_dau_ky,
pp.prev_quarter AS quy_dau_ky,
SUM(d.data_value) AS vcsh_dau_ky

FROM tp
CROSS JOIN prev_period pp
JOIN cp ON cp.rn = 1 AND cp."IssuerName" = tp."IssuerName"
JOIN IDS.company_profiles p ON p.equity_ticker = cp.equity_ticker
JOIN IDS.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN IDS.company_data e ON e.company_profile_id = p.id -- Lấy kỳ TRƯỚC (= đầu kỳ hiện tại)
AND e.report_year = pp.prev_year
AND e.report_quarter = pp.prev_quarter
JOIN IDS.data d ON d.company_data_id = e.company_data_id
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id = rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
WHERE tp.rn = 1
AND rc2.col_desc = '1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
AND (
(rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'dn' AND rr.row_desc = '400')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'bh' AND rr.row_desc = '400')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd = 'td' AND rr.row_desc = '500')
)

GROUP BY
tp."symbol",
c.industry_cd,
c.industry_name,
cp.equity_ticker,
pp.prev_year,
pp.prev_quarter;

-- Tỷ lệ dư nợ margin / VCSH
WITH margin_data AS (
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE N'%II. Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%' THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND mr.REPORT_YEAR = :p_nam
AND mr.PERIOD = :p_thang
AND :p_thang BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
-- AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
),
vcsh_data AS (
SELECT
mr.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
mr.PERIOD AS thang,
SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.ROW_NAME) LIKE N'%I. Vốn chủ sở hữu%' THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS von_chu_so_huu
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr
JOIN SSC_SCMS.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRLCTCK'
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTCR'
AND rcv.COLUMN_NAME LIKE N'%số cuối năm%'
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6)
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH'
AND mr.REPORT_YEAR = :p_nam
AND mr.PERIOD = :p_thang
AND :p_thang BETWEEN 1 AND 12
AND mr.VERSION = (
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION)
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID
AND mr2.REPORT_YEAR = mr.REPORT_YEAR
AND mr2.PERIOD = mr.PERIOD
)
-- AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD
)
SELECT
margin_data.nam,
margin_data.thang,
margin_data.du_no_margin,
vcsh_data.von_chu_so_huu,
ROUND(
margin_data.du_no_margin
/ NULLIF(vcsh_data.von_chu_so_huu, 0)
* 100,
2
) AS ty_le_margin_vcsh_pct
FROM margin_data
LEFT JOIN vcsh_data
ON vcsh_data.nam = margin_data.nam
AND vcsh_data.thang = margin_data.thang
ORDER BY margin_data.nam, margin_data.thang;

SELECT

COUNT(CASE WHEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE >= 120

COUNT(CASE WHEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE < 120 THEN 1 END) AS so_ctck_tlvkd_thap
FROM (
SELECT ADD_MONTHS(
TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:p_nam_tu) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(:p_thang_tu), 2, '0') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'),
LEVEL - 1
) AS thang
FROM DUAL
CONNECT BY ADD_MONTHS(
TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:p_nam_tu) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(:p_thang_tu), 2, '0') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'),
LEVEL - 1
) <= TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:p_nam_den) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(:p_thang_den), 2, '0') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM')
) nd
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE,
TRUNC(mr.DATA_DATE, 'MM') AS thang,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
PARTITION BY mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, TRUNC(mr.DATA_DATE, 'MM')
ORDER BY mr.DATA_DATE DESC
) AS rn
FROM SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv
JOIN SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr ON mr.ID = rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID
JOIN SSC_SCMS.CAT_INDICATOR ci ON ci.ID = rcv.INDICATOR_ID
WHERE ci.INDICATOR_CODE = 'TY_LE_VON_KHA_DUNG' -- Xác nhận
AND mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3)
AND rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE IS NOT NULL
) rcv ON rcv.thang = nd.thang AND rcv.rn = 1
GROUP BY nd.thang
ORDER BY nd.thang;

column19:
WITH daily_kl AS (
-- Bước 1: tính KLGD từng phiên giao dịch
SELECT
TRUNC(t."Trade date") AS trade_date,
SUM(t."Trade quantity") AS kl_ngay
FROM MSS.Trade_HNX t
INNER JOIN MDDS.JAD_STOCKINFOR si ON t."Issue Code" = si."symbol"
WHERE t."Market ID" = 'DVX'
AND si.underlyingSymbol = 'VN30'
AND si.FloorCode = '03'
AND si.StockType = 'FU'
AND TRUNC(t."Trade date") <= TRUNC(:p_date) -- tính đến ngày báo cáo
GROUP BY TRUNC(t."Trade date")
),
top50 AS (
-- Bước 2: lấy 50 phiên gần nhất
SELECT kl_ngay
FROM daily_kl
ORDER BY trade_date DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
)
-- Bước 3: tính trung bình
SELECT
ROUND(AVG(kl_ngay), 0) AS kl_tb_50_phien
FROM top50;

- Số cổ phiếu đang lưu hành: Lấy từ VSDC - Báo cáo Thông tin khối lượng chứng khoán cuối ngày (TT138.2025.TT.BTC - Mẫu số 01 Báo cáo ngày)
column19:
SELECT
cp.symbol,
cp.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
cp.tradingdate,
lnst.industry_cd,
lnst.industry_name,
lnst.report_year,
lnst.report_quarter,
lnst.lnst/NULLIF(scplh.KLLH,0) AS eps,
-- P/E = Giá đóng cửa / EPS
cp.closePrice/NULLIF(lnst.lnst/NULLIF(scplh.KLLH,0),0) AS pe
FROM (
SELECT
symbol,
closePrice,
tradingdate
FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
WHERE tradingdate=:input_date
AND FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')
) cp
JOIN (
SELECT
cp2.equity_listing_exch_cd,
cat.industry_cd,
cat.industry_name,
cp2.report_type_cd,
cd.report_year,
cd.report_quarter,
SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
FROM IDS.data d
JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
JOIN IDS.company_data cd ON d.company_data_id=cd.id
JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp2 ON cp2.id=cd.company_profile_id
JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp2.category_id
WHERE rc2.col_desc='1'
AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
AND cd.report_year=:year
AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
AND ((rc.enterprise_type_cd='dn' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='bh' AND rr.row_desc='60')
OR (rc.enterprise_type_cd='td' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
GROUP BY
cp2.equity_listing_exch_cd,
cat.industry_cd,
cat.industry_name,
cp2.report_type_cd,
cd.report_year,
cd.report_quarter
) lnst
ON cp.symbol=lnst.equity_listing_exch_cd
JOIN (
SELECT
MCK,
SUM(Khối_lượng_chứng_khoán_đang_lưu_hành) AS KLLH
FROM BM1_Báo_cáo_về_khối_lượng_chứng_khoán_đang_lưu_hành
WHERE Mã_chứng_khoán='Cổ phiếu'
GROUP BY MCK
) scplh
ON cp.symbol=scplh.MCK
ORDER BY
cp.symbol,
lnst.report_year,
lnst.report_quarter;

SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(rcv.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE N'%II. Giá trị chứng khoán ký quỹ%' THEN rcv.NUMERIC_VALUE ELSE 0 END) AS du_no_margin 
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr 
JOIN SSC_SCMS.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID 
JOIN SSC_SCMS.FORM_REPORT fr ON fr.ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID 
AND fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHDKD_TH' 
JOIN SSC_SCMS.REPORT_CELL_VALUE rcv ON rcv.MEMBER_REPORT_ID = mr.ID 
AND rcv.SHEET_NAME = N'BCTHHD' -- Xác nhận tên sheet BC tình hình hoạt động 
WHERE mr.RECORD_STATUS IN (2, 3, 6) -- 2=đúng hạn, 3=trễ, 6=nộp lại 
AND mr.REPORT_PERIOD = 'TH' -- Kỳ tháng 
AND mr.REPORT_YEAR = :p_nam -- VD: 2025 
AND mr.PERIOD = :p_thang -- VD: 1, 2, 3,..., 12 
AND :p_thang BETWEEN 1 AND 12 
-- Chỉ lấy version mới nhất nếu nộp lại 
AND mr.VERSION = ( 
SELECT MAX(mr2.VERSION) 
FROM SSC_SCMS.MEMBER_REPORT mr2 
WHERE mr2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID 
AND mr2.FORM_REPORT_ID = mr.FORM_REPORT_ID

)

GROUP BY mr.REPORT_YEAR, mr.PERIOD

SELECT
v.PERIOD_YEAR AS nam,
v.PERIOD_VALUE AS quy,
v.VALUE * CASE v.UNIT_CODE
WHEN 3 THEN 1e9
WHEN 8 THEN 1
ELSE 1
END AS gdp_vnd
FROM SIT_MRMS.RISK_INDICATOR_VALUE v
JOIN SIT_MRMS.RISK_INDICATOR i ON i.ID = v.INDICATOR_ID
WHERE i.INDICATOR_CODE = 'GDP_VN'
AND v.PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND i.DELETED = 0
AND v.DELETED = 0

column3: Vốn hóa thị trường
column19:
WITH gtgd AS (
SELECT SUM(t.[Execution - Value]) AS tong_gtgd
FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('HSX','STX','STO')
UNION ALL
SELECT SUM(CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC) * t.[Trade quantity]) AS tong_gtgd
FROM Trade_HNX t
WHERE t.[Trade date] = :ngay_gd
AND t.[Market ID] IN ('HNX','UPX')
),
gdp_quy AS (
SELECT
v.PERIOD_YEAR AS nam,
v.PERIOD_VALUE AS quy,
v.VALUE * CASE v.UNIT_CODE WHEN 3 THEN 1e9 WHEN 8 THEN 1 ELSE 1 END AS gdp_vnd,
LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(v.PERIOD_YEAR||LPAD(v.PERIOD_VALUE*3,2,'0')||'01','YYYYMMDD')) AS ngay_cuoi_quy
FROM SIT_MRMS.RISK_INDICATOR_VALUE v
JOIN SIT_MRMS.RISK_INDICATOR i ON i.ID = v.INDICATOR_ID
WHERE i.INDICATOR_CODE = 'GDP_VN'
AND v.PERIOD_TYPE = 3
AND i.DELETED = 0
AND v.DELETED = 0
),
gdp_nearest AS (
SELECT gdp_vnd, nam, quy, ngay_cuoi_quy
FROM gdp_quy
WHERE ngay_cuoi_quy <= :ngay_gd
ORDER BY ngay_cuoi_quy DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
)
SELECT
:ngay_gd AS ngay_gd,
SUM(g.tong_gtgd) AS tong_gtgd_vnd,
gdp.gdp_vnd AS gdp_vnd,
gdp.nam AS gdp_nam,
gdp.quy AS gdp_quy,
ROUND(SUM(g.tong_gtgd) / NULLIF(gdp.gdp_vnd,0) * 100, 4) AS gtgd_gdp_pct
FROM gtgd g
CROSS JOIN gdp_nearest gdp
GROUP BY gdp.gdp_vnd, gdp.nam, gdp.quy;
